sections.Profile:
The "Mardi Gras" pinball machine, released by Williams Electronic Mfg. Co. in October 1962, is a four-player electro-mechanical game designed by Steve Kordek.

- Manufacturer: Williams Electronic Games Inc.
- Years made: 1962
- In production: no
- Type: Electro-Mechanical
- Display: Reels
- Players: 4
- Tags: Party, Good Times, Carnival, Dancing, Original Theme, Festival, Music
sections.Design Team:
- Design: Steve Kordek
- Mechanics: Steve Kordek
sections.Editions: - Mardi Gras: 1,100 made, released 1962-10-01, model number 277
